FC-RDS500-4R Radar-Vision Fusion System

Applications: Precision 24/7 perimeter security; radar-vision integrated surveillance; autonomous target identification and tracking; active deterrent and non-kinetic intervention; rapid tactical deployment.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The FC-RDS500-4R radar-vision fusion intelligent electronic sentinel system is a wide-area panoramic radar-vision fusion equipment product. Target detection is realized by the cooperation of a four-sided array radar and a PTZ camera, perfectly combining the active detection and high sensitivity of radar technology with the visibility and intelligence of video, greatly improving the detection rate of the system in complex environments.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Key Features

  • Adopts composite detection of radar and camera, combining active and passive detection, which can meet the requirements of day and night and all-weather work.
  • Radar-vision intelligent fusion, vision fuses the target information of radar, to track, image, and intelligently identify interested moving targets in the defense area.
  • Integrated design of detection and warning, supports tweeter + strobe light, supports optional green laser dazzling, in order to warn intruding targets.
  • The whole machine is light in weight and small in size, easy to install and maintain, supports optional 4G/5G transmission and photovoltaic integrated station, significantly improving construction efficiency and reducing construction costs.
  • Quasi-spherical structure design, strong load capacity, fast rotation speed, better wind resistance and anti-shake performance, clearer imaging.

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
Overall Performance1. Target Recognition: Pedestrians, vehicles 2. Scanning Range: 360° full coverage 3. Recognition Distance: Pedestrian (RCS 0.5㎡) ≥500m, Vehicle (RCS 5㎡) ≥700m
Radar1. Radar Type: 1T8R FMCW 2. Ranging Accuracy: ±0.75m 3. Range Resolution: 1.5m 4. Beam Width: Azimuth (-6dB): 360°, Elevation (-6dB): 13° 5. Angle Measurement Accuracy: ±1°
HD Visible Light1. Working Distance: Medium vehicle (4.6m×2.3m): 7000m, Standing person (1.7m×0.5m): 5000m 2. Sensor: Back-illuminated starlight-grade CMOS 3. Resolution: 1920×1080 4. Illumination: Color 0.01Lux, B/W 0.001Lux 5. Lens Focal Length: 7mm～300mm 43x optical zoom, 16x digital zoom focus control: manual/auto focus
Laser Illumination1. Illumination Distance: 300m 2. Laser Type: New HD floodlight homogenized light source, no speckle particles 3. Illumination Angle: 1°～20°
Sound and Light WarningBuilt-in integrated tweeter + strobe light, supports custom alarm sound, supports replacing with green laser dazzling
Camera PTZ1. Rotation Speed: Horizontal: 0.01°/s～180°/s; Tilt: 0.01°/s～120°/s, supports focal length adaptive speed 2. Rotation Angle: Horizontal: 360° continuous rotation; Tilt: -90°～+90° 3. Preset Cruise: 3000 presets, supports 16 cruise routes, each can support 256 presets
Intelligence1. Intelligent Analysis: Supports region intrusion detection, tripwire intrusion detection, motion detection, cruise detection as well as loitering detection, gathering detection, stay detection, reverse direction detection, etc. 2. Auto Tracking: Supports multi-scene tracking, alarm linkage tracking
Interface Protocol1. Communication and Control: RJ45 / dual LC fiber cascade
Power Supply1. Power Supply Range: AC220V±20% 2. Peak Power Consumption: ≤160W
Dimensions315mm×300mm×480mm (L×W×H)
InstallationFixed installation / tripod temporary mount, recommended installation height is 3～5m
Environmental Adaptability1. Working Temperature: -40℃～60℃ 2. Working Humidity: ≤95% RH 3. Protection Level: IP66
Edge Smart Box1. AI Performance: 21 TOPS 2. Memory: 8GB 3. Cores: GPU 384 cores, CPU 6 cores 4. Alarm Access: Supports external RS485 vibration sensor 5. Weight: ≤5kg 6. Dimensions: 347mm×210mm×98mm 7. Protection Level: IP65
CustomizationSupports customized function development
